decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 9 backtested attempts, score 0.9815. Series context: trend strength 0.982 and seasonal strength 0.654; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.018); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.444.
